title: Positive local stiffness alone does not capture every initial position
statement: Introduced10um sphere,2MHz/.3MPa trap and .5MHz/1MPa activation give positive local combined K=8.532202080e-7N/m. With20um/s stream, stable point14.494656um has finite basin. Immediate activation from120um leaves the187.5um half-cell at sampled.072s. Trap-only .4s first brings it to4.77937342um; subsequent one-second activation stays within20um and ends14.3439356um. These are finite trajectories, not exact event times, measured capture or a measured cure.
